name: @forwardimpact/svcpathway
description: Engineering standard queries over gRPC — career paths and agent profiles as derivable data for products.
author: D. Olsson <hi@senzilla.io>

jobs.trigger: A developer builds a product feature that needs career paths or agent profiles. The derivation logic must then live in the product.
jobs.bigHire: query the engineering standard from any product without embedded derivation logic.
jobs.littleHire: fetch a derived role or agent profile without a second implementation of the derivation.
jobs.competesWith: libskill embedded in each product; duplicate derivation logic; hardcoded role definitions
